policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en la calle y lotes cercanos en Mystic.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Street parking and nearby municipal lots available in Mystic.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y reservaciones en Resy.

products.descriptionEs: Mejillones frescos con opción de caldo rojo o blanco.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh mussels prepared in your choice of red or white broth.

products.descriptionEs: Salsa pomodoro y ricotta hecha en casa.
products.descriptionEn: Served with pomodoro and house-made ricotta.

products.descriptionEn: Red pearl onions, capers, olive oil, and parmesan cheese.

products.descriptionEn: Fingerling potato, tomato, peas, basil, and corn.

products.descriptionEn: Meyer lemon risotto, corn, arugula, and chili.

products.descriptionEn: Lemon garlic linguine topped with freshly grated parmesan cheese.

products.descriptionEn: Served with chimichurri and hand-cut fries.

products.descriptionEn: House-made pasta with rich Bolognese sauce, parmesan, and basil.

products.descriptionEn: Fish, scallops, clams, mussels, shrimp, spicy tomato broth, and linguine.

products.descriptionEs: Rellenos de ricotta, salsa de vodka cremosa, albahaca y parmesano.
products.descriptionEn: Ricotta filling tossed in a vodka sauce with basil and parmesan.

products.descriptionEn: Hand-crafted ricotta gnocchi served with pomodoro and parmesan cheese.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con varias opciones marcadas en nuestro menú. Pregunte a su mesero para más detalles.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we feature several marked options on our menu. Please ask your server for details.

faqs.qEn: How can I make a reservation?
faqs.aEs: Puede reservar fácilmente a través de Resy en nuestro sitio web o llamándonos directamente al 860.536.3228.
faqs.aEn: You can easily book reservations via Resy on our website or by calling us directly at 860.536.3228.

faqs.qEn: Do you make your own pasta?
faqs.aEs: ¡Sí! Todas nuestras pastas, salsas, panes y postres se elaboran completamente en casa todos los días.
faqs.aEn: Yes! All of our pastas, sauces, breads, and desserts are made entirely in-house.
